check_code: if (isDeadServer(serverName)) throw new RegionServerStoppedException(...) where serverName comes from the hbase:meta region location
check_semantics: The client compares the region server reported by hbase:meta with its dead-server status listener before caching that location. The selected exception is a target event, not automatically a correctness bug.
cluster_type: HBaseTestingUtility MiniHBaseCluster with two region servers
workload: Unmodified original JUnit method inherited by HBase01RecordingTest. The subclass only registers process identity and request tracing around the test lifecycle; no workload steps or assertions are changed.
oracle: The selected locateRegionInMeta guard's fatal branch (site #u222=false), which leads to the RegionServerStoppedException throw at site #u234. Require a post-injection target event with the same runtime occurrence address.
coverage_type: GraphChecker-instrumented method entry and branch outcome IDs in the woven HBase client slice; not full-system basic-block coverage
coverage_note: The first IOException trial adds 16 production branch outcomes, mainly through meta-lookup retry. The SocketTimeoutException variant and ordered two-fault sequence add no further production branch outcomes; the two injected fault-gate outcomes are excluded.

faults: meta scan response SocketTimeoutException at #u126 on retry

timing_note: Approximate case wall time from the first static-attempt log (2026-10-06T18:00:06Z) to the final double-fault trial (2026-10-06T18:18:57Z). Includes exploratory instrumentation correction and healthy runs; excludes source audit before the first log. The counted healthy run took 29.53 s; counted fault runs took 93.53 s in total.
stop_reason: The two observed meta-scan response exception kinds and their ordered combination matched exact runtime identities, retained the selected target, and plateaued in method and production branch coverage. This is a bounded family result. The test did not drive a dead-server status transition or a region-server crash, so other fault families remain untested.
causal_limit: The source guard also depends on clusterStatusListener.isDeadServer(serverName), where serverName is parsed from hbase:meta. An exception at the scanner response can cause a retry but does not itself establish a changed dead-server status. No causal claim beyond the precise local fault-to-retry-to-target sequence is made.
